# dim_terms_conditions_templates

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_terms_conditions_templates` · dbt area: `portal`

Dimension table for Terms and Conditions templates which advisors send to clients to clarify the advisor-client relationship. Each row represents a single template. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `agreement_form_template_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each Terms & Conditions agreement template. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | When the Terms & Condition template was archived by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the Terms & Condition template was created by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions template has been archived. Note when a template is archived, its pending forms using this template are automatically archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `was_customized` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions template was customized by the Advisor or used with Fora's quick start template.  >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_template_active` | True/False flag indicating whether this Terms & Conditions template is active. An Advisor will only ever have a single “active” T&C that they can send as T&C forms. Once a template is archived, it is no longer active >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp of when the template was last updated by the Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
